When a job fails after its voice was made, the voice is kept; the customer can start a new job with it and pay only for the video. Saving every voice is a setting, off by default.
Videos up to 60 seconds for now (D-056); longer only after an owner-approved live run. Photos follow the model's documented rules: at least 300 px, ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1 (D-057).
Banners appear only after the customer switches on "Add banners" (off by default); without banners there is no joining step on the progress screen.
The customer pays a payment fee (2% by default, a setting; GST on the fee optional) on top of the credits, shown before paying; the fee never becomes credits. Minimum purchase 1,000 credits.
A customer short of credits for a ready video can add credits from the review screen and return to the same video, where Approve is then enabled.
Every customer screen works on Android phones, iPhones, tablets and desktops. Tested range (assumed, D-069): 320 to 1920 px wide, portrait and landscape, in Chromium and WebKit.
source: Owner, 2026-11-17 ("enterprises level responsive ... all the devices should support responsiveness of this website")

requirement: Before the voice is made, the customer chooses a gender (male or female) and then one of the ready-made voices of that gender.
The customer can play a sample of the selected voice before continuing.
A Punjabi customer can record themselves reading the script with a microphone; the recording becomes the video's audio and the voice step costs 10 credits.
A recorded voice must be the customer's own; a separate consent is required and stored with the job.

A customer can clone their own voice and save up to 3 voices: 150 credits once per voice, then 10 credits per video; 150 returned on a clear failure, kept until staff review when the outcome is unclear.
A cloned voice id can be used by the speech model, and a cloned voice sounds acceptable in Hindi.
